title: Malmgren's IDA work a cover for the NSC; Bissell diaries
place_text: Institute for Defense Analyses / White House

tellings.quote: And he said in a 2024 interview before he interviewed with me that his work at the IDA was actually a cover for what he was doing for the National Security Council in the White House.

plain: A former Washington official named Harold Malmgren is said to have stated, in a 2024 interview given before he spoke with Michels, that his job at the Institute for Defense Analyses, a defense research group, was really a cover for work he did for the National Security Council, the president's own security staff in the White House. Michels reports this himself, and ties it to Malmgren's diaries and to the CIA official Richard Bissell. It matters because it would place Malmgren closer to secret 1960s decision-making than his public job suggests.
